_stress_scenario: Two documents for the same encounter disagree on severity (non-perforated vs. perforated appendicitis). The correct ICD-10/CPT pair depends on the pathology report, not the surgeon's intra-op impression. Tests whether extraction reconciles across documents and prefers the more definitive source instead of taking the first one seen.

documents.text: Preop dx: acute appendicitis. Laparoscopic appendectomy performed. Appendix appeared inflamed but intact, no gross perforation noted intraoperatively. Specimen sent to pathology.
Final diagnosis: acute appendicitis with periappendiceal abscess and frank perforation of the appendiceal tip. Purulent exudate present.
